hook: One day left: who will control Congress?
reel_hook: Tomorrow, America picks who runs Congress

slides.title: US midterms are tomorrow
slides.image_prompt: White domed capitol building at dawn with red and blue ballot boxes on the steps and flag bunting, empty voting booths nearby
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats vote Tuesday.
WHY IT MATTERS
It decides who controls Congress for Trump's final two years.
FOR YOU
Results aren't final on election night, so expect updates until certification.
slides.body: All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats vote Tuesday. It decides who controls Congress for Trump's final two years. Results aren't final on election night, so expect updates until certification.

slides.title: Oil drops on Iran deal hopes
slides.image_prompt: Oil tanker sailing through a calm narrow strait at sunrise, barrels on the dock, a falling red arrow made of rope on the water
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran-Qatar talks ended with a draft US deal circulating.
WHY IT MATTERS
Brent oil fell 4.2% on hopes Hormuz could reopen.
FOR YOU
Fuel prices could ease if a deal holds, but nothing is signed yet.
slides.body: Iran-Qatar talks ended with a draft US deal circulating. Brent oil fell 4.2% on hopes Hormuz could reopen. Fuel prices could ease if a deal holds, but nothing is signed yet.

slides.title: Bulgaria's first woman president
slides.image_prompt: White, green and red Bulgarian flag waving above a wooden ballot box in an empty marble hall, soft morning light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Acting President Iliana Iotova won the runoff with 57.58%.
WHY IT MATTERS
She's Bulgaria's first elected female head of state.
FOR YOU
Expect her to push for a negotiated end to the Ukraine war.
slides.body: Acting President Iliana Iotova won the runoff with 57.58%. She's Bulgaria's first elected female head of state. Expect her to push for a negotiated end to the Ukraine war.

slides.title: Jet crash in Florida kills nine
slides.image_prompt: Empty airport runway at dusk with soft blue runway lights fading into the distance, calm quiet sky, somber mood
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A Bahamas-bound Learjet 60 crashed in Greenacres, Florida.
WHY IT MATTERS
All nine aboard died; the cause is not yet known.
FOR YOU
The FAA and NTSB will investigate; no cause has been confirmed yet.
slides.body: A Bahamas-bound Learjet 60 crashed in Greenacres, Florida. All nine aboard died; the cause is not yet known. The FAA and NTSB will investigate; no cause has been confirmed yet.

slides.title: F1's youngest champion ever
slides.image_prompt: Silver Formula One car parked on a sunlit race track with a golden trophy beside it and Italian flag colors in the stands
slides.label: SPORT
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Kimi Antonelli, 20, clinched the F1 title in Mexico City.
WHY IT MATTERS
He's Italy's first world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
FOR YOU
Italy's 73-year wait is over, and Verstappen won the race by 0.7s.
slides.body: Kimi Antonelli, 20, clinched the F1 title in Mexico City. He's Italy's first world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953. Italy's 73-year wait is over, and Verstappen won the race by 0.7s.
